description: API layer: remove the LOW-risk auto-APPROVE override and the majority-vote fallback in routes.py /process so the final decision comes only from the Judge; return the canonical §10 response shape (preserving every existing frontend key) sourced from state.ruling / state.risk_breakdown / state._comm_drafts / state.master_form; add the new endpoints and the schemas.py response models with no duplicate handlers. Design §9, §10, §11. Depends on FEAT-002 and FEAT-003. Blocks FEAT-005 (integration tests hit /process) and FEAT-006 (frontend consumes the shape).
steps: Edit backend/agentcore/api/routes.py /process: delete the 'if risk_label == "LOW" ...' override block and the 'if verdict is None:' majority-vote fallback block. Derive recommendation only from state.ruling per design §9: APPROVE->APPROVE, REJECT->REJECT, FLAG or requires_human_review->REVIEW; state.ruling is None -> recommendation 'REVIEW', requires_human True, blockingConditions += ['judge_unavailable'], HTTP 200 (never crash, never auto-approve).

In /process read riskScore/riskLabel from state.risk_breakdown['overall_review_risk'] (score and band), NOT by splitting tags; remove the fragile float(t.split('_')[1]) logic. Read email/whatsapp from state._comm_drafts (email_draft/sms_draft) with the default template only as last-resort fallback; remove the dead COMMUNICATION-finding read loop.

Add a null-safe adapter deriving legacy claimData from state.master_form (design §10): patientName=patient.name.value, diagnosis=clinical.primary_diagnosis.value, diagnosisCode=(clinical.diagnosis_codes.value or [None])[0], cptCode=(first procedure code or [None])[0], provider=provider.hospital_name.value, totalBilled=billing.submitted_total.value or 0, dateOfService=hospitalization.admission_date.value. MISSING fields map to null, never raise.

Add the new canonical blocks to the /process response: masterClaimForm (state.master_form), riskBreakdown (state.risk_breakdown), decision {outcome, requiresHumanReview, confidence, rationale, blockingConditions, basis}, provenanceSummary {extracted, missing, conflict, lowConfidence, verified}, agentFindings (full AgentFinding dumps), debate {occurred, rounds} (real rounds only — occurred=false with empty rounds when analysts agreed), logs (state._step_logs), jurisdiction. Keep every existing key (claimData, riskScore, riskLabel, recommendation, riskReasons, extractionIssues, extractionTextPreview, riskModel, email, whatsapp, findings, stage, decisionSteps).

Add new handlers to the single `router` (each live at / and /v2 via the existing double-mount; register ONCE each, no duplicates): POST /claims/upload (store file+text, return claim_id, do not run pipeline), POST /claims/{id}/extract (Scanner+OCR only, persist+return master_form), GET /claims/{id}/master-form (404 if not extracted), POST /claims/{id}/validate (run Validator, return categorized findings), POST /claims/{id}/process (full pipeline on stored claim, synchronous, returns §10 shape — distinct from /process which runs on upload), GET /claims/{id}/findings, GET /claims/{id}/decision, GET /claims/{id}/logs (AuditRepository.get_trail when persisted else state._step_logs with 'persisted': false), POST /claims/{id}/reprocess. Extend the existing get_claim_status + ClaimStatusResponse with decision + provenance_summary (do not add a second handler).

Edit backend/agentcore/api/schemas.py: add MasterFormResponse, DecisionResponse, FindingsResponse, LogsResponse, ValidateResponse, ProvenanceSummary (wrapping serialized dicts as dict[str, Any] to avoid re-duplicating the big schema), and extend ClaimStatusResponse. Keep /health/agents returning all 10 AgentRole values (test_health_agents asserts len==10).
Keep the router double-mount in app.py unchanged (do not remove either include_router call).
acceptance_criteria: The LOW-risk auto-APPROVE override and the `if verdict is None:` majority-vote fallback no longer exist in routes.py.

A /process run returns recommendation sourced from state.ruling only, plus the new masterClaimForm/riskBreakdown/decision/provenanceSummary/agentFindings/debate/logs/jurisdiction blocks and all legacy keys.
The new endpoints are reachable and each handler is registered exactly once (no duplicate handler definitions).
GET /health/agents returns 10 agents; the existing 5 tests still pass.
verification: d:\ClaimBlitz\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from agentcore.api.app import create_app; app=create_app(); paths={r.path for r in app.routes}; assert '/claims/{claim_id}/master-form' in paths and '/v2/claims/{claim_id}/master-form' in paths" (cwd backend) — exits 0.
findings:
LANDED. Existing 5 backend tests green (~9.3s); both FEAT-004 verification commands exit 0 (create_app() import; route-presence for '/claims/{claim_id}/master-form' AND '/v2/claims/{claim_id}/master-form'). End-to-end /process on the synthetic PDF (degraded-LLM offline path) returns HTTP 200, recommendation 'REVIEW' sourced ONLY from state.ruling, all 21 keys present, null-safe claimData (all MISSING -> null, no raise).

=== routes.py CHANGES (design §9/§10/§11) ===
DELETED from /process: the `if risk_label == "LOW" ...` auto-APPROVE override AND the `if verdict is None:` majority-vote fallback AND the fragile `float(t.split('_')[1])` / tag-split risk parsing AND the dead COMMUNICATION-finding read loop. Recommendation now derived in `_recommendation_from_ruling(state)`: APPROVE->APPROVE, REJECT->REJECT, FLAG/requires_human_review->REVIEW; state.ruling is None -> 'REVIEW' + requiresHumanReview True + blockingConditions += ['judge_unavailable'], HTTP 200 (never crash/auto-approve). riskScore/riskLabel read from state.risk_breakdown['overall_review_risk'] {score, band}; band uppercased for riskLabel; when risk_breakdown absent default 0.0/'MEDIUM'. email/whatsapp read from state._comm_drafts (email_draft/sms_draft) with template fallback. Null-safe claimData adapter from state.master_form (_claim_data_adapter). Single shared builder `_build_process_response(state, raw_text, claim_id)` used by /process, POST /claims/{id}/process, /reprocess, and the /claims async background task; `_run_and_store` persists the response on the blackboard so GET endpoints serve it without re-running.

=== EXACT /process RESPONSE KEYS (for FEAT-005 integration tests + FEAT-006 frontend) ===
Legacy (preserved): claimData {patientName,diagnosis,diagnosisCode,cptCode,provider,totalBilled,dateOfService}, riskScore (float), riskLabel ('LOW'|'MEDIUM'|'HIGH'), recommendation ('APPROVE'|'REVIEW'|'REJECT'), riskReasons (list[str]), extractionIssues (list[str] dotted paths), extractionTextPreview (raw_text[:500]), riskModel {engine,modelName,baseScore,maxIssuePenalty,issuePenaltyPerItem,thresholds,contributions[]}, email (str), whatsapp (str), findings [{agent,verdict,confidence,reasoning}], stage (str), decisionSteps (int).
New canonical blocks: masterClaimForm (serialized MasterClaimForm, or {} if none), riskBreakdown (serialized RiskBreakdown, or {}), decision {outcome,requiresHumanReview,confidence,rationale,blockingConditions,basis[{source,evidence}]}, provenanceSummary {extracted,missing,conflict,lowConfidence,verified}, agentFindings (full AgentFinding model_dumps), debate {occurred,rounds} (real DebateRounds only; occurred=false+[] when no disagreement), logs (state._step_logs rows), jurisdiction (master_form.jurisdiction dict).

=== NEW ENDPOINT PATHS (each registered ONCE on `router`; live at BOTH '/<path>' and '/v2/<path>' via the app.py double-mount, which is unchanged) ===
POST /claims/upload -> 201 {claim_id,stage,filename,message}; stores file+text, does NOT run pipeline.
POST /claims/{claim_id}/extract -> MasterFormResponse {claim_id,masterClaimForm,jurisdiction,provenanceSummary}; Scanner+OCR (build_master_form) only; persists master_form; degrades to all-MISSING baseline on failure.
GET /claims/{claim_id}/master-form -> MasterFormResponse; 404 if not extracted/processed.
POST /claims/{claim_id}/validate -> ValidateResponse {claim_id,verdict,findings[AgentFinding dump]}; runs Validator against stored (or freshly-extracted) form; degrades to ABSTAIN finding on LLM failure (never 500).
POST /claims/{claim_id}/process -> canonical §10 shape (full pipeline on stored claim, synchronous; distinct from /process which runs on upload).
POST /claims/{claim_id}/reprocess -> canonical §10 shape (re-run full pipeline on stored claim).
GET /claims/{claim_id}/findings -> FindingsResponse {claim_id,agentFindings}.
GET /claims/{claim_id}/decision -> DecisionResponse {claim_id,decision}; 404 if not processed.
GET /claims/{claim_id}/logs -> LogsResponse {claim_id,logs,persisted}; AuditRepository.get_trail when Mongo persisted (persisted=true) else state._step_logs from stored response (persisted=false).
EXTENDED (no second handler): GET /claims/{claim_id} (get_claim_status) + ClaimStatusResponse now also return `decision` (dict|None) and `provenance_summary` (ProvenanceSummary|None) from the stored process_response; risk_score/risk_label backfilled from riskBreakdown.overall_review_risk. The async POST /claims background task now also stores the canonical process_response on the blackboard.
/process (root alias of /v2/process) unchanged in path+verb; POST (upload-and-run) is still the single run-on-upload endpoint. No duplicate handlers (verified: exactly one handler per route, 30 claim paths total = 15 unique * 2 mounts).

=== schemas.py ADDITIONS ===
ProvenanceSummary {extracted,missing,conflict,lowConfidence,verified}; MasterFormResponse; DecisionResponse; FindingsResponse; ValidateResponse; LogsResponse {logs,persisted}; UploadResponse; extended ClaimStatusResponse (+decision, +provenance_summary). All big-schema sub-objects typed as dict[str,Any] (authoritative schema stays in claim_model.py). /health/agents still returns all 10 AgentRole values (test_health_agents green). app.py double-mount intact (both include_router calls unchanged).

FILES CHANGED (committed on feat/master-claim-form, NOT pushed): backend/agentcore/api/routes.py, backend/agentcore/api/schemas.py.
